quests.instruction: Your grandmother's granddaughter, other than yourself and your own sister, is your ___?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: She must come through a different one of your grandmother's children — your aunt or uncle.
quests.explanation: Your grandmother's granddaughter, other than yourself and your own sister, is your cousin, since she comes through your aunt or uncle.
quests.funFact: You and your cousins can all be granddaughters or grandsons to the very same grandmother!

quests.instruction: What does your sibling's daughter call your mother?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: Your sibling's daughter is your niece, and your mother is your niece's grandparent.
quests.explanation: Your sibling's daughter calls your mother 'Grandmother', since your mother is her grandparent too.
quests.funFact: The very same woman is 'Mother' to you and 'Grandmother' to your niece or nephew, all at once!

quests.instruction: Your mother's father's brother is your ___?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: Your mother's father is your grandfather — his brother holds this title for you.
quests.explanation: Your mother's father's brother is your great-uncle, since your mother's father is your grandfather.
quests.funFact: A great-uncle belongs to the very same generation as your own grandparents!

quests.instruction: What does your cousin call your father?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: Your cousin's parent is your father's own sibling — so your father holds this title to your cousin.
quests.explanation: Your cousin calls your father 'Uncle', since your father is your cousin's parent's sibling.
quests.funFact: The very same man is 'Father' to you and 'Uncle' to your cousin, all at once!

quests.instruction: Your daughter's son is your ___?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: He is two generations below you, and is a boy.
quests.explanation: Your daughter's son is your grandson.
quests.funFact: The same boy is a grandson to you and a son to your own daughter!

quests.instruction: Your father's sister is your ___?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She is your father's own sibling.
quests.explanation: Your father's sister is your aunt.
quests.funFact: An aunt on your father's side is connected to you through his side of the family!

quests.instruction: Your father's father is your ___?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: Count up just one generation from your father.
quests.explanation: Your father's father is your grandfather.
quests.funFact: Every person has exactly two grandfathers: their mother's father and their father's father!

quests.instruction: Your sibling's daughter, whether your brother's or your sister's, is your ___?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: It does not matter which sibling — a sibling's daughter always holds this title.
quests.explanation: Your sibling's daughter, whether your brother's or your sister's, is your niece.
quests.funFact: This word works no matter which of your siblings the child belongs to!

quests.instruction: Your father's mother's sister is your ___?
quests.question: Great-Aunt
quests.hint: Your father's mother is your grandmother — her sister holds this title for you.
quests.explanation: Your father's mother's sister is your great-aunt, since your father's mother is your grandmother.
quests.funFact: Chaining together relationships like this is the heart of reading any family tree!

quests.instruction: Your sibling's son, whether your brother's or your sister's, is your ___?
quests.question: Nephew
quests.hint: It does not matter which sibling — a sibling's son always holds this title.
quests.explanation: Your sibling's son, whether your brother's or your sister's, is your nephew.
quests.funFact: One family can have nephews from several different siblings all at once!

quests.instruction: If a girl calls you 'Grandma' or 'Grandpa', what is she to you?
quests.question: Granddaughter
quests.hint: This girl is the daughter of one of your own children.
quests.explanation: If a girl calls you 'Grandma' or 'Grandpa', she is your granddaughter.
quests.funFact: Family titles work in pairs — if she calls you 'Grandma', you call her 'Granddaughter' right back!

quests.instruction: Your parent's grandmother is your ___?
quests.question: Great-Grandmother
quests.hint: Count up: your parent, then their grandparent, then one more step for you.
quests.explanation: Your parent's grandmother is your great-grandmother.
quests.funFact: Your parent grew up hearing stories from their own grandmother, just as you might from yours!

quests.instruction: Your grandmother's father is your ___?
quests.question: Great-Grandfather
quests.hint: Your grandmother has exactly one father — he is this relative.
quests.explanation: Your grandmother's father is your great-grandfather.
quests.funFact: Your grandmother grew up being raised by her own father, just like you were raised by yours!

quests.instruction: Everyone who shares your home address makes up your ___?
quests.question: Household
quests.hint: This word is defined by a shared address, not just blood relation.
quests.explanation: Everyone who shares your home address makes up your household.
quests.funFact: A household can include family members and sometimes even close family friends who live together!

quests.instruction: If a woman calls you 'son' or 'daughter', what is she to you?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: Think about who you might call 'Mom'.
quests.explanation: If a woman calls you 'son' or 'daughter', she is your mother.
quests.funFact: Family titles work in pairs — if she calls you her child, you call her 'Mother' right back!

quests.instruction: Your parent's cousin's child is your ___?
quests.question: Second Cousin
quests.hint: Your parent's cousin's connection to you is one generation further than a regular cousin.
quests.explanation: Your parent's cousin's child is your second cousin, since the shared relative is a great-grandparent.
quests.funFact: Second cousins share a great-grandparent, one generation further back than regular cousins!

quests.instruction: Your aunts, uncles, cousins, and grandparents together make up your ___?
quests.question: Extended Family
quests.hint: This is the wider circle beyond your own household.
quests.explanation: Your aunts, uncles, cousins, and grandparents together make up your extended family.
quests.funFact: Extended family gatherings are a wonderful way to feel connected to your whole family tree!

quests.instruction: If a man calls you 'son' or 'daughter', what is he to you?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: Think about who you might call 'Dad'.
quests.explanation: If a man calls you 'son' or 'daughter', he is your father.
quests.funFact: Family titles work in pairs — if he calls you his child, you call him 'Father' right back!

quests.instruction: Family members who lived before you were born, going back many generations, are your ___?
quests.question: Ancestors
quests.hint: This word names the earlier branches of your family tree.
quests.explanation: Family members who lived before you were born, going back many generations, are your ancestors.
quests.funFact: Studying your ancestors is a hobby called genealogy, enjoyed by people all over the world!

quests.instruction: Family members who will be born after you, in future generations, are your ___?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: This word names the newer branches of your family tree.
quests.explanation: Family members who will be born after you, in future generations, are your descendants.
quests.funFact: A family tree can keep growing new descendants for as long as the family continues!

quests.instruction: Your parents, your siblings, and yourself together make up your ___?
quests.question: Immediate Family
quests.hint: This is your smallest, closest circle of relatives.
quests.explanation: Your parents, your siblings, and yourself together make up your immediate family.
quests.funFact: Your immediate family is usually the group you see and live with every single day!

quests.instruction: All of your grandparents, born around the same era, make up one ___?
quests.question: Generation
quests.hint: This word groups relatives by age level.
quests.explanation: All of your grandparents, born around the same era, make up one generation.
quests.funFact: You share your own generation with your siblings and cousins, even though you all have different parents!

quests.instruction: Your father's sister's child is your ___?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: Your father's sister is your aunt — her child holds this title for you.
quests.explanation: Your father's sister's child is your cousin, since your father's sister is your aunt.
quests.funFact: This two-step puzzle combines two relationships you already know into one new answer!

quests.instruction: If a woman calls you 'grandson' or 'granddaughter', what is she to you?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is one generation above your own parent.
quests.explanation: If a woman calls you 'grandson' or 'granddaughter', she is your grandmother.
quests.funFact: Family titles work in pairs — if she calls you her grandchild, you call her 'Grandmother' right back!

quests.instruction: Your grandmother's brother is your ___?
quests.question: Great-Uncle
quests.hint: He is your grandmother's own sibling, one generation further than an uncle.
quests.explanation: Your grandmother's brother is your great-uncle.
quests.funFact: Great-uncles and great-aunts are wonderful sources of extra-old family stories!

quests.instruction: Your cousin's father is your ___?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: Since your cousin is the child of your parent's sibling, his father is that sibling.
quests.explanation: Your cousin's father is your uncle, since your cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle.
quests.funFact: The very same man is 'Dad' to your cousin and 'Uncle' to you, all at once!

quests.instruction: Your child's son, whether your son's or your daughter's, is your ___?
quests.question: Grandson
quests.hint: It does not matter which of your children — their son always holds this title.
quests.explanation: Your child's son, whether your son's or your daughter's, is your grandson.
quests.funFact: This word works no matter which of your children the boy belongs to!

quests.instruction: Your cousin's mother is your ___?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: Since your cousin is the child of your parent's sibling, her mother is that sibling.
quests.explanation: Your cousin's mother is your aunt, since your cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle.
quests.funFact: Tracing back from a cousin to their parent is a great way to double-check a family connection!

quests.instruction: Your mother's father is your ___?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: Your mother has exactly one father — he is this relative.
quests.explanation: Your mother's father is your grandfather.
quests.funFact: You can have up to two grandfathers: your mother's father and your father's father!

quests.instruction: Your sister's daughter is your ___?
quests.question: Niece
quests.hint: This girl calls you 'Aunt' or 'Uncle'.
quests.explanation: Your sister's daughter is your niece.
quests.funFact: A niece often loves hearing stories about what her own parent was like as a child!
